notes.label: Create a new ice room with at least three connected cross repositioning stages, a cross-braked turn onto the gem route, and an alive return to the starting doorway.
notes.goal: Create a new ice room with at least three connected cross repositioning stages, a cross-braked turn onto the gem route, and an alive return to the starting doorway.
notes.change: Start from the empty template with a smaller inset ice basin, an asymmetric seven-member cross, and three interior pier stops. Place the gem inside the stopping graph rather than at a trivial boundary stop. Derive useful docking poses from this new footprint and verify them through ordinary engine motion.
notes.reason: The longer upper and right arms change remote collision stops and usable input sides. A lower interior gem needs a stopping turn; the same cross must make that turn usable while preserving a return path. Do not transfer the source's pose coordinates or direction order.
expectedChecks: Frozen cross and forbidden cross braking each exclude completion
At least three functional motions supported by prefix dependencies
Directed stopping graphs and actual next pushes
Saved-build ordinary replay and separate browser play/save/export

notes.label: Make the first cross input reachable from the doorway without adding floor-based free turning.
notes.goal: Make the first cross input reachable from the doorway without adding floor-based free turning.
notes.change: Add a top-edge pier at (9,2), stopping the initial rightward slide at (8,2), aligned with the cross's longer right arm.
notes.reason: The first diagnostic exhausts just four corner stops: no player ray meets the cross. The new pier should create a downward approach to a real arm face and let ordinary search evaluate the resulting preparation chain.
expectedChecks: A usable initial cross input exists
Braking and multiple cross motions remain necessary

notes.label: Bind the three functional stages to the dependencies actually demonstrated by the new basin.
notes.goal: Bind the three functional stages to the dependencies actually demonstrated by the new basin.
notes.change: Declare upward preparation, right docking at center (8,4), and lower alignment at center (8,9). Use the 19-input complete route as the ordinary witness, with next input faces at (5,5) and (10,3).
notes.reason: The first downward parking pose and the exact upper-left pose each have bypasses, so neither is declared necessary. The separate directional prefix search excludes docking without upward motion. Docking is necessary before lower alignment, and lower alignment is necessary for the full objective. Long static brakes are required somewhere in every completion, but the gem is collected during the final cross push in this witness.
expectedChecks: Directed next-stance access after each stage
No completion using at most two cross motions
